legend: During the research on properties of the greatest common divisor (GCD) of a set of numbers, Ildar, a famous mathematician, introduced a brand new concept of the weakened common divisor (WCD) of a list of pairs of integers.

For a given list of pairs of integers (a1,b1)$$$(a_1, b_1)$$$, (a2,b2)$$$(a_2, b_2)$$$, ..., (an,bn)$$$(a_n, b_n)$$$ their WCD is arbitrary integer greater than 1$$$1$$$, such that it divides at least one element in each pair. WCD may not exist for some lists.

For example, if the list looks like [(12,15),(25,18),(10,24)]$$$[(12, 15), (25, 18), (10, 24)]$$$, then their WCD can be equal to 2$$$2$$$, 3$$$3$$$, 5$$$5$$$ or 6$$$6$$$ (each of these numbers is strictly greater than 1$$$1$$$ and divides at least one number in each pair).
You're currently pursuing your PhD degree under Ildar's mentorship, and that's why this problem was delegated to you. Your task is to calculate WCD efficiently.
input: The first line contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤150000$$$1 \le n \le 150\,000$$$) — the number of pairs.
Each of the next n$$$n$$$ lines contains two integer values ai$$$a_i$$$, bi$$$b_i$$$ (2≤ai,bi≤2⋅109$$$2 \le a_i, b_i \le 2 \cdot 10^9$$$).
output: Print a single integer — the WCD of the set of pairs.
If there are multiple possible answers, output any; if there is no answer, print −1$$$-1$$$.
note: In the first example the answer is 6$$$6$$$ since it divides 18$$$18$$$ from the first pair, 24$$$24$$$ from the second and 12$$$12$$$ from the third ones. Note that other valid answers will also be accepted.
In the second example there are no integers greater than 1$$$1$$$ satisfying the conditions.
In the third example one of the possible answers is 5$$$5$$$. Note that, for example, 15$$$15$$$ is also allowed, but it's not necessary to maximize the output.

legend.ai: 在研究一组数的最大公约数（GCD）的性质时，著名数学家 Ildar 提出了一个全新的概念：一列整数对的弱化公约数（WCD）。
对于给定的一列整数对 (a1,b1)$$$(a_1, b_1)$$$, (a2,b2)$$$(a_2, b_2)$$$, ..., (an,bn)$$$(a_n, b_n)$$$，它们的 WCD 是任意一个大于 1$$$1$$$ 的整数，且该整数能整除每对中的至少一个元素。有些列表可能不存在 WCD。
你目前正在 Ildar 的指导下攻读博士学位，因此这个问题被交给了你。你的任务是高效地计算 WCD。

input.ai: 接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 ai$$$a_i$$$、bi$$$b_i$$$(2≤ai,bi≤2⋅109$$$2 \le a_i, b_i \le 2 \cdot 10^9$$$)。

output.ai: 如果有多个可能的答案，输出任意一个；如果不存在答案，输出 −1$$$-1$$$。

note.ai: 第一个样例中，答案是 6$$$6$$$，因为它能整除第一组数对中的 18$$$18$$$、第二组数对中的 24$$$24$$$，以及第三组数对中的 12$$$12$$$。注意，其他合法答案也会被接受。
第二个样例中，不存在大于 1$$$1$$$ 且满足条件的整数。
第三个样例中，一个可能的答案是 5$$$5$$$。注意，例如 15$$$15$$$ 也是允许的，但不必让输出最大化。
